seo.title: About RNC Landscaping | Greater Victoria Landscapers
seo.description: Meet RNC Landscaping, a local landscaping contractor serving Greater Victoria homes, stratas and businesses. Learn how we work and keep crews safe on site.

lede: A local contractor for grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree work across Greater Victoria.

items.title: Say what we'll do, then do it
items.body: A written scope and a clear schedule, so you see the plan before work starts.

items.title: Respect the property
items.body: We protect lawns, beds and structures, and clean up before we leave.

items.title: Respect the rules
items.body: We check watering rules and tree bylaws first, and point you to the source.

items.title: Be a good neighbour
items.body: We plan around noise, parking and debris on the streets we work on.

sections.heading: Safety
body: Safety comes before speed. Crews plan each job, use the right protective equipment and stop work when conditions are unsafe. WorkSafeBC: [WORKSAFEBC STATUS]. Insurance: [LIABILITY LIMIT].

sections.heading: Our workmanship guarantee
body: Our guarantee on workmanship: [WARRANTY]. If something we did is not right, [tell us](/contact/). [How we handle a concern](/process/) explains what happens next.

sections.heading: Work with us
body: See [our services](/services/), browse [sample projects](/projects/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
Read [how we work](/process/), from first request to finished job.
